title: Yoisaki Kanade — Memories Reclaimed〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, you thought you heard a child's voice, and then found a glowing shard by the lake...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right... I made sure not to touch it, but it suddenly flashed, and before I knew it I was here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were talking to a smaller version of yourself when we arrived.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: I've been waiting so, so long...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That girl had somewhat of a strange air to her...
It felt like she was you, but not.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
...
Whoever she is, there's no mistake that she knows this SEKAI's secrets.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, what about you two? What brought you here...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We also heard the girl's voice, and were looking for the source. That was when we saw you by the lake...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We went after you when you got pulled into this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for being here. If it were just me, I don't think I'd ever figure out what to do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, it's nice to hear we have your confidence.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But this is all new to us as well, so we don't know what to do either.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, but don't you think that's better than panicking?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We're lacking information.
Let's have a look around.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I suppose.
Okay, Kanade. Let's hold hands so you don't get lost.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, pictures of me?
What are they doing here, and so many...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm sure this is related to the place we're in somehow.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Was this one taken at one of your after-parties with the others?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, we're at that diner, so I think so.
Oh, and this one's from the tea party we had last White Day...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It looks like a birthday photo.
Hehe, little Kanade's trying her hardest to blow out the candles on her cake.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Okay, can you blow out all the candles?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Ah, wait! The camera, let me get the camera!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
*Blow*
*Blow*
Aww, the candles won't go out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha. Try taking a deep, deep breath and blowing as hard as you can.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you recall ever telling anyone about the moment in this photo, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think I have. Until recently, I've kept myself from remembering any of the time I spent with my family...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think that's why for a lot of these photos, I can't recall the moment they were taken, even when I'm looking at them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We are talking about when you were very little. It's quite possible you've simply forgotten because of how long it's...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think I understand what that other little Kanade meant when she said “Don't forget again.”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And the nature of this SEKAI too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This SEKAI...
It was born from your feelings, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If there were only photos of your family, it could possibly have been your dad's feelings... But Mafuyu and the others are here as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
But what feeling of mine would do this...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What you said a minute ago is essentially the answer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whether they've been whittled down or shattered, the feelings that form this place have lost their true shape.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In all likelihood, that happened because you thought you didn't deserve to wish, and constantly kept them buried.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know you feel awful about what happened to your dad, but there's no point in beating yourself up...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What I'm trying to say is... I think your happiness is a separate issue.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I still can't do what you were able to, Dad, but there is someone who really needs my songs now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because if I can do that... If I can make others happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope you pat my head...
And praise me for not giving up all this time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Even for just a moment...
If it means regaining...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. I'll keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
Oh, but what happened to that shard of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It returned to you when that SEKAI dissipated.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But why were my feelings here...?
This is Mafuyu's SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If I had to guess, maybe they were able to take shape by leaning on the power of this SEKAI's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All in the hopes that you would take notice of them before they disappeared forever...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's also possible that you yourself didn't want to lose them, and your self-defense mechanisms kicked in to prevent that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't want to lose them...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll say this. What becomes of that shard from now on is up to you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you end up suppressing your feelings again...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right, I'll make sure to be careful of that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: After all, you and Ena...so many people helped me remember them.
